note: The UAL megafiles are build INPUTS, not deliverables — 20 MB each, of which three quarters is animation data any given app will not play. What publishes is the curated subset in derived/. Re-cut a different subset by editing `convert` rather than by serving the source. Clips are split across BOTH megafiles (ClimbLedge is UAL1, ClimbUp_1m/2m are UAL2), so `merge` grafts the UAL2 ones onto UAL1's skeleton — safe because the two share it exactly: identical node and joint lists, identical order, zero bind-pose differences, verified before it was built.
